status: 博士论文公共定义及新实验基准；不追溯改写旧结果

channel.source: 与当前Capacity Reserve默认参数一致，仅作为新实验的共同起点
channel.meaning: 确定性通信质量代理；不代表bit/s、丢包率或实测RSSI

conventions.dynamics: single_integrator: dot(p_i)=u_i; other dynamics require an explicit extension
conventions.vector_storage: positions and velocities (N,d); columns in mathematics; 0-based Python indices
conventions.candidate_graph_default: all unordered pairs; explicit sparse candidates must be recorded
conventions.active_edges: positive physical weight; no silent hard threshold
conventions.communication_graph: declared separately; equality with physical graph is an experiment assumption
conventions.input_set: must explicitly choose ball_l2, box_linf or unbounded; no common numeric default
